QUOTE: With the compile-time macros set, `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is compiled out (`platform.c:20-22`); calling it then is a link error, not a silent no-op.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the setter is compiled out on the macro path and that calling it gives a link error, so it is absent rather than present and ignored.
